$comment: Pins the Zeebe revision the engine-test corpus is harvested from (#1249). `sha` is the camunda/camunda commit the test sources are read from; it MUST stay equal to formal/parity/zeebe-pin.json's sha so the harvested scenarios tag against the same extracted surface (check.mjs enforces this). `modelVersion` is the released io.camunda:zeebe-bpmn-model Maven artifact the extractor serialises models through — the released artifact closest to the pinned branch (stable/8.10 -> 8.10.x). `testPaths` are the engine-test roots scanned for Bpmn.createExecutableProcess models. fetch-tests.sh sparse-fetches them; harvest.mjs reads them.
